Identity remains essential, but value capture can shift toward broader cloud/security suites if standalone differentiation weakens.
Expectation-sensitive valuation can react negatively even when recurring metrics remain strong if revenue or margins miss elevated assumptions.

ARR can overstate near-term economic conversion if treated as revenue because it is an annualized operating metric, may temporarily include contracts under renewal negotiation after expiration, and is not standardized across issuers.

Identity-security value capture remains exposed to successful AI integration, interoperability, cloud-service reliability and competitive response even as the underlying identity-control need expands.
Issuer release and 8-K are not independent corroboration of the same issuer-originated operating claims.
Demanding valuation, GAAP losses, dilution and suite competition leave the thesis sensitive to growth deceleration.
